raw_segments.text: Yago, you or any man living may be drunk at a time, man.
I'll tell you what you shall do.
Our General's wife is now the General.
I may say so in this respect, for that he hath devoted and given up himself to the contemplation,
mark and denotement of her parts and graces.
Impertune her help to put you in your place again.
She is of so free, so kind, so apt, so blessed a disposition.
She holds it a vice in her goodness not to do more than she has requested.
This broken joint between you and her husband entreat her to splinter, and my fortunes against
any lay worth naming, this crack of your love shall grow stronger than it was before.
